description: Fault-mode library. Each rule maps a component category to ordered fault-mode candidates. The first mode whose criteria match the observed evidence is assigned to a hypothesis (component + fault mode). Assignment is deterministic and does not alter the evidence ranking.

fallback.label: degraded / suspect
fallback.verification: Measure the rail and re-verify functional tests after reseating
fallback.mechanism: component behavior is outside specification without a dominant single mode

fault_modes.label: output undervoltage
fault_modes.verification: Measure output rail under rated load and compare against the expected window
fault_modes.mechanism: an output undervoltage starves every downstream functional block that depends on this rail

fault_modes.label: output overvoltage
fault_modes.verification: Measure output rail under no-load and rated load; confirm regulation
fault_modes.mechanism: an output overvoltage stresses all downstream loads and may trip protection

fault_modes.label: shorted output / low impedance
fault_modes.verification: Isolate the component from the rail and measure impedance to ground
fault_modes.mechanism: a short pulls the rail low and propagates as a cascade to dependents

fault_modes.label: open pin / cold solder
fault_modes.verification: Visual inspection plus continuity from pin to pad
fault_modes.mechanism: an open connection removes the component's function from the circuit without a short

fault_modes.label: functional failure (no response / no boot)
fault_modes.verification: Verify clock, reset, and supply at the device, then re-run the functional test
fault_modes.mechanism: the device is powered but not responding; function is lost without a direct rail deviation

fallback.label: suspect inductor
fallback.verification: Measure DC resistance across the inductor and inspect the solder joints
fallback.mechanism: inductor behavior is outside expectation without a dominant single mode

fault_modes.label: open circuit
fault_modes.verification: DC resistance check across the part (expect near-zero ohms)
fault_modes.mechanism: an open inductor interrupts the rail path entirely, so all downstream loads lose supply

fault_modes.label: saturated / partial degradation
fault_modes.verification: Measure the rail under load; a saturated inductor sags under current
fault_modes.mechanism: partial conduction keeps the rail present but unable to hold regulation under load

fault_modes.label: shorted winding
fault_modes.verification: Impedance to ground with the part isolated
fault_modes.mechanism: a shorted winding bypasses the inductor's filtering behavior

fallback.label: degraded capacitance
fallback.verification: Capacitance and ESR measurement with the part removed
fallback.mechanism: a drifted capacitor weakens filtering without hard failure

fault_modes.label: shorted / cracked body
fault_modes.verification: Impedance to ground with the part isolated
fault_modes.mechanism: a cracked capacitor can short the rail it decouples, cascading to every dependent

fault_modes.label: open / tombstoned
fault_modes.verification: Visual inspection and continuity from pad to pad
fault_modes.mechanism: an open capacitor removes its decoupling; ripple appears under load

fault_modes.label: degraded capacitance
fault_modes.verification: Capacitance and ESR measurement with the part removed
fault_modes.mechanism: a drifted capacitor weakens filtering without hard failure

fallback.label: value drift
fallback.verification: Measure resistance with the part isolated
fallback.mechanism: the resistor is present but out of tolerance

fault_modes.label: open circuit
fault_modes.verification: DC resistance check (expect the marked value)
fault_modes.mechanism: an open resistor removes bias or pull-up function from the net

fault_modes.label: value drift
fault_modes.verification: Measure resistance with the part isolated
fault_modes.mechanism: the resistor is present but out of tolerance

fallback.label: gate-drive / switching failure
fallback.verification: Verify gate drive and measure drain-source behavior with the load disconnected
fallback.mechanism: the transistor is not switching as commanded

fault_modes.label: shorted drain-source
fault_modes.verification: Drain-source resistance with the device off
fault_modes.mechanism: a shorted device stays on regardless of gate state

fault_modes.label: open channel
fault_modes.verification: Continuity check with the device on
fault_modes.mechanism: an open channel never conducts, so the load stays off

fault_modes.label: gate-drive / switching failure
fault_modes.verification: Verify gate drive and measure drain-source behavior with the load disconnected
fault_modes.mechanism: the transistor is not switching as commanded

fallback.label: contact degradation
fallback.verification: Inspect the connector and verify continuity across each pin
fallback.mechanism: a marginal contact produces intermittent or degraded signals

fault_modes.label: pin short
fault_modes.verification: Continuity between adjacent pins with power removed
fault_modes.mechanism: a shorted connector pin can back-feed or sink an entire rail

fault_modes.label: disconnected / open pin
fault_modes.verification: Continuity from connector pin to board pad
fault_modes.mechanism: an open pin removes the external supply or signal path

fallback.label: opened (protection trip)
fallback.verification: Continuity across the protective element; verify the load for the cause before replacement
fallback.mechanism: the protective element has opened — either by design (overcurrent) or failure

fault_modes.label: opened (protection trip)
fault_modes.verification: Continuity across the protective element; verify the load for the cause before replacement
fault_modes.mechanism: the protective element has opened — either by design (overcurrent) or failure

fallback.label: open feed / disconnected
fallback.verification: Continuity from the radio port to the antenna feed point
fallback.mechanism: an open feed drops radiated power while the radio itself may be healthy

fault_modes.label: open feed / disconnected
fault_modes.verification: Continuity from the radio port to the antenna feed point
fault_modes.mechanism: an open feed drops radiated power while the radio itself may be healthy

default_fallback.label: degraded / suspect
default_fallback.verification: Isolate the component and verify its characteristic behavior
default_fallback.mechanism: component behavior is outside specification without a dominant single mode
